parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Separate variables and attempt integration of at least one side — B1. Obtain terms $\ln y$ and $\frac12x$ — B1. Guidance: work from $\int\frac1y\,dy=\int k\,dx$; the B marks are not available for fortuitously correct answers. Use $x=4,y=3$ to evaluate a constant or as limits in a solution containing $a\ln y+bx$, where $ab\ne0$ — M1. Obtain a correct solution in any form, e.g. $\ln y=\frac12x+\ln3-2$ — A1. Obtain $y=3e^{x/2-2}$, or equivalent — A1. Guidance accepts $y=e^{x/2+\ln3-2}$, $y=e^{(x-1.80)/2}$ and $y=3\sqrt{e^{x-4}}$; $|y|=\ldots$ scores A0. Total: 5.
